parameters.revision: T02 / battery above DAC / bottom jack
parameters.status: Nominal mechanical prototype. Vendor XIAO and Adafruit geometry; panel, flex folds, SD assembly and interface PCB require sample verification.
parameters.layout_basis: Latest user instruction: battery above DAC, intact Adafruit jack at bottom; photo supplies landscape screen and left SD / right USB arrangement.

display.status: Outer glass 43 x 36 supplied by user; radius 7 and LCD outline estimated from photos. Active rectangle remains an estimate; UI is clipped at the rounded border.
display.flex_status: Right-edge exits observed in photo; inward 180-degree fold is a proposed route, not a measured flex or qualified bend. Nominal inside bend radius 1.4 mm; verify stiffeners and usable length.

battery.status: 503040 protected pack from P04 and user chart; nominal 40 x 30 x 5 including finished-pack allowance. Verify protection end and connector against sample.

electronics.label: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3
electronics.status: Unscaled Seeed STEP; USB right; no fitted headers.

electronics.label: Adafruit #6309 / intact jack
electronics.status: Unscaled intact Adafruit STEP rotated -90 degrees about Z. Original jack faces bottom and its bore is centered at case X=0. Full 7.1 mm product height reserved.

electronics.label: microSD PCB + socket / nominal
electronics.status: 22 x 18 PCB allowance from chart; detailed representative low-profile cage and card. No selected module drawing.

electronics.label: Touch / display interface PCB / custom
electronics.status: Custom PCB on removable carrier behind display. Must be designed and manufactured; no assumed off-the-shelf breakout fit.

electronics.status: Representative underside-mounted ZIF facing right; contact side and housing require verification.

validation.revision: T02 / battery above DAC / bottom jack
validation.status: Nominal mechanical prototype. Vendor XIAO and Adafruit geometry; panel, flex folds, SD assembly and interface PCB require sample verification.

thickness_study.basis: Fixed selected boards, 1.2 mm skins, DAC underside Z=1.8, full vendor height 7.1, minimum rear clearance 0.3. This is a conditional stack bound, not a global optimization or a measured fit.

validation.scope: All inter-part CAD intersections, empty routing allowances, outer containment, panel insertion, shell continuity and port cutters. Vendor internal construction is retained. Flex geometry, connector selection, solder/lead details, tolerances and real assembly remain unverified. Screw root geometry omits threads.
